newsitem.title: USA: Department 56 orders down through mid-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Department 56 orders down through mid-Feb.

text.p: Department 56 Inc said dealer orders through February 15 were down 11 percent from the year ago period.
Reorders of existing products were down as dealer inventory levels were sufficient for many items, the giftware distributor said in a news release late Thursday.

"Although substantial efforts were taken in 1996 to reduce inventory at retail, 1997 will continue to be a year of transition, as retailers work to further reduce their inventory," chief executive officer Susan Engel said in the news release.
Orders for new product introductions continue to be strong, the company said.
Also late Thursday, the company reported net income of $4.2 million or $0.19 a share in the fourth quarter, down from $5.5 million or $0.25 a share a year ago.
Shares of Department 56 plunged 4-1/2 to 19-3/8 Friday.
